description: Geological Survey and Mining Management Agency (經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心) is a data repository run by Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan. The agency publishes geological maps, active-fault, landslide and geologically sensitive area data and geotechnical borehole information for Taiwan through its geological data portals. Coverage: Taiwan. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as shp, wms, pdf; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心 - 首頁") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support geohazard and ground-condition inputs for Taiwan infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
